text:
If I recall correctly your partner paid a deposit for you to arrive, right?
This , B2, visa is so you can arrive.
Edited after I checked some of your other posts.
You are married, right?
So once you arrive to Israel notify your MH.
If they don't answer straight away you can go there together with your husband.
They should give you the B1 and then 6 months later the interview to get the A5.
